args.content:
## Hawaii Vacation Packing List

### Clothing
- Lightweight swimwear
- Quick-dry shorts and t-shirts
- Lightweight long-sleeve shirts for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals
- Light jacket or sweater for evenings
- Hiking boots (optional for hikes)

### Sun Protection
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Sunglasses
- Sun hat
- Lip balm with SPF

### Toiletries
- Travel-sized shampoo, conditioner, body wash
- Toothbrush, toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Travel-sized laundry detergent
- Feminine hygiene products (if needed)
- Prescription medications

### Electronics
- Smartphone and charger
- Travel adapter (US plug to Hawaii plug)
- Portable power bank
- Headphones or earbuds
- Camera or GoPro

### Miscellaneous
- Travel documents and passport
- Small first-aid kit
- Water bottle
- Snorkel and mask (if planning to snorkel)
- Beach towel
- Travel journal or notebook
- Travel insurance documents
- Extra money or credit card
